sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful: it targets ships, uses the authoritative owner paths, links the ice-load design case to each structural member load case, pairs effect and location values, enforces the lower-capacity comparison direction, and retains the required minimization evidence. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary repair is needed.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the true memberCapacityMinimizationConfirmed flag is only presence/evidence and does not verify the required comparison that the ice-load patch is applied where the member capacity under combined bending and shear is minimised. Add a direct-static comparison constraint (with the required member, load-case, patch-location, and capacity linkage) establishing that minimisation, and ensure the selected load case represents the ice-load-patch design relationship rather than merely requiring unrelated operand values.

Reject: the comparison is not semantically faithful because it compares the selected member's capacity with every other member's capacity without requiring the other member's load case to have the same combinedShearBendingEffect and loadPatchApplicationLocation as the selected case. Add explicit equality filters (or an equivalent paired-case constraint) for selectedEffect=otherEffect and selectedLocation=otherLocation, while retaining the required designCase-to-structuralMember-load-case linkage and the lower-capacity violation test. Preserve the prior direct-static comparison instruction; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

The candidate is semantically faithful: it targets ships, uses the authoritative owner paths, links the ice-load design case to each structural member load case, pairs effect and location values, enforces the lower-capacity comparison direction, and retains the required minimization evidence. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary repair is needed.
